end.summary: Discussed speed as distance divided by time, including 100 m in 5 s and 80 m in 4 s = 20 m/s.
end.parentNote: Asha practised speed, velocity direction, and acceleration using a braking example. Diya correctly worked out (0 − 25) ÷ 5 = −5 m/s² and later connected the negative sign with leftward direction; the mix-up about braking having zero acceleration was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen: true). At home, draw a number line with 0 and −5, then add a left-pointing arrow and explain what each represents.
